description: Build the complete Node.js+Express backend: project scaffold, SQLite migrations, formula service with full unit tests, product CRUD API, sales+restock API with transactional stock movements, dashboard API, and demo seed endpoint. This is independent of the frontend and must be completed first so the frontend can call real endpoints.
steps: Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/package.json with exact dependencies: runtime: express@^4.18.0, better-sqlite3@^9.4.3, cors@^2.8.5; devDeps: typescript@^5.3.0, @types/express, @types/better-sqlite3, @types/cors, @types/node, ts-node-dev@^2.0.0, jest@^29, @types/jest, ts-jest@^29, supertest@^6, @types/supertest. Scripts: dev (ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts), build (tsc), test (jest). Run: cd smart-inventory-optimization/backend && npm install.
Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/tsconfig.json: compilerOptions strict:true, outDir:dist, rootDir:src, module:commonjs, target:es2020, esModuleInterop:true, resolveJsonModule:true.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/db/database.ts: open better-sqlite3 on 'inventory.db' (path relative to the file location using path.join(__dirname, '../../inventory.db')), run PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL and PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON, export the db instance.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/db/migrations.ts with runMigrations(db) using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for: (1) products — id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, sku TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, current_stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, supplier_lead_time_days INTEGER NOT NULL, safety_stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, target_coverage_days INTEGER NOT NULL, is_sample INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL; (2) sales_records — id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sale_date TEXT NOT NULL, units_sold INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(product_id, sale_date); (3) stock_movements — id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, movement_date TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/index.ts: import express, cors, db, runMigrations, and all route files. Call runMigrations(db) at startup. Mount routes. Add GET /api/v1/health → {status:'ok'}. Listen on port 3001.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/services/inventory.ts with 8 pure exported formula functions (JSDoc on each): calcADD7(totalUnitsInWindow: number): number (returns totalUnitsInWindow / 7); calcADD3(totalUnitsInWindow: number): number (returns totalUnitsInWindow / 3); calcROP(add7: number, leadTimeDays: number, safetyStock: number): number (returns Math.ceil(add7 * leadTimeDays + safetyStock)); calcStockCoverage(currentStock: number, add7: number): number | null (returns null if add7===0, else currentStock/add7); calcTargetStock(add7: number, leadTimeDays: number, targetCoverageDays: number, safetyStock: number): number; calcSuggestedOrderQty(targetStock: number, currentStock: number): number (Math.max(0, Math.ceil(targetStock) - currentStock)); calcStatus(currentStock: number, rop: number): 'Reorder now' | 'Watch' | 'Healthy' (currentStock<=rop→'Reorder now'; currentStock<=rop*1.25→'Watch'; else 'Healthy'); calcTrendWarning(add3: number, add7: number): boolean (add3 > add7 * 1.20).

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/services/inventory.test.ts with Jest tests covering: calcADD7 normal (21 units → 3.0), zero (0→0), partial week; calcADD3 normal (12→4.0), zero; calcROP normal (add7=5,lead=5,safety=5→30), add7=0 (→safety_stock), zero safety; calcStockCoverage normal, add7=0→null; calcSuggestedOrderQty normal, stock>=target→0, never negative; calcStatus: stock<rop→'Reorder now', stock=rop→'Reorder now', stock=rop*1.25→'Watch', stock>rop*1.25→'Healthy'; calcTrendWarning: add3=add7*1.21→true, add3=add7→false.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/routes/products.ts implementing GET /api/v1/products (ORDER BY name ASC), POST /api/v1/products (validate all fields, INSERT, 201; 409 on duplicate SKU 'SKU already exists'), GET /api/v1/products/:id (404 if missing), PUT /api/v1/products/:id (validate+UPDATE), DELETE /api/v1/products/:id (204; cascade removes related rows). All SQL uses prepared statements.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/routes/sales.ts with: GET /api/v1/products/:id/sales (last 30 days DESC); POST /api/v1/products/:id/sales using db.transaction(): (1) SELECT old units_sold for (product_id, sale_date), (2) delta = newQty-(oldQty??0), (3) if current_stock-delta<0 throw error with exact message 'Cannot record sale: would reduce stock below zero (current: N, requested: M)', (4) INSERT OR REPLACE sales_records, (5) UPDATE products current_stock-=delta, (6) INSERT stock_movements type='sale' quantity=-delta; POST /api/v1/products/:id/restock using db.transaction(): UPDATE current_stock+=quantity, INSERT stock_movements type='restock' quantity=+quantity note=optional; GET /api/v1/products/:id/movements (last 60 days DESC).

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/routes/sales.test.ts (Jest+supertest) covering: POST sale decrements stock; POST sale rejects on negative stock (400 with exact error message); POST same product+date twice results in one row and delta-only stock adjustment; POST restock increments stock; GET movements returns correct entries with correct types and signed quantities.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/routes/dashboard.ts implementing GET /api/v1/dashboard: for each product query SUM(units_sold) WHERE sale_date >= date('now','-6 days') for ADD7 window and >= date('now','-2 days') for ADD3 window; call all formula functions from inventory service; sort results by status priority (Reorder now=0, Watch=1, Healthy=2) then name ASC. Response includes all product fields plus add7, add3, rop, stockCoverageDays, targetStock, suggestedOrderQty, status, trendWarning.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/seed/demo-data.ts with seedDemoData(db) function: DELETE existing is_sample=1 products first; INSERT 3 products with exact fields from plan.md DEMO SEED DATA section; INSERT sales_records directly (bypassing transaction route) with dates relative to new Date(): Coffee days -13..-7 → 3 units/day, days -6..0 → 6 units/day; Flour days -13..0 → 8 units/day; Oil days -13..0 → 2 units/day. Helper: dateOffset(n: number): string returns new Date() offset by n days as YYYY-MM-DD.

Create smart-inventory-optimization/backend/src/routes/seed.ts with POST /api/v1/seed (calls seedDemoData) and DELETE /api/v1/seed (DELETE FROM products WHERE is_sample=1). Register this route in src/index.ts.
acceptance_criteria: cd smart-inventory-optimization/backend && npm test passes all tests (inventory formula tests + sales route tests, zero failures)
POST /api/v1/seed followed by GET /api/v1/dashboard returns Coffee Blend as first item with status:'Reorder now' and trendWarning:true
POST /api/v1/products/:id/sales with qty > current_stock returns 400 with error containing 'would reduce stock below zero'
POST sale then check products/:id confirms current_stock decreased by the sold quantity
POST restock then check products/:id confirms current_stock increased by the restock quantity
DELETE /api/v1/seed then GET /api/v1/dashboard returns empty array
POST /api/v1/products with duplicate SKU returns 409 {error:'SKU already exists'}
verification: cd smart-inventory-optimization/backend && npm install && npm test
cd smart-inventory-optimization/backend && npm run build (tsc compiles without errors)
Start server (npm run dev), then: curl http://localhost:3001/api/v1/health
Start server, POST to /api/v1/seed, then GET /api/v1/dashboard and verify first item has status:'Reorder now' and trendWarning:true
